svg.text: hole: grown-up pokes with a pencil/awl
Calibration: the black bar must measure
exactly 100 mm and the square 20x20 mm.
Use card ~1 mm (cereal box) for parts.
github.com/dev-repos/kids-robotics-projects · Kids.JoinDev · CC BY 4.0 · Grown-ups do all craft-knife cutting.
3 mm corrugated cardboard. Trace and cut each leg TWICE, glue the two layers = one strong 6 mm leg.
Hip hole, slot and sole must stay on one straight line (the centre line) - that is what makes the foot glide flat.
Glue a sole stick under each long foot (toe forward).
GRIP: 2 rubber bands round each foot -
the swinging foot pushes, so it must not slide.
Skewer Ø3 + straw Ø5 - true length:
Wheel axle: skewer 110 mm (as before). Stoppers: 4 cardboard buttons Ø10 (sheet 3) glued on pin/peg ends.
